description: Sakura diorama: Trunk, Blossoms and tiered Base, plus a Props group (pond, water, bridge, lantern, rocks, grass, flowers, lily pads)
author: seasonal-qr contributors
slotsFormat: {"name":"sakura","baseSize":72,"palette":["#rrggbb" x 8],"slots":[[x,y,z,p],...]}: baseSize = width of the base top; palette = sRGB hex per slot class 0-7, the Principled base colour of the material the class samples (canopy 1-3: the deepest, second and palest canopy materials; stone: Lantern; wood: Bridge, carried although class 5 is empty), from which the app derives every QR colour. Slots in GLB space (Y up), 2 decimals, 5,000 slots (3,000 lawn, 2,000 non-lawn) in one seeded shuffle stratified by class, so any prefix keeps the class proportions. Light modules and the quiet zone take lawn slots (p = 4), dark modules the rest.

slotClasses.0: trunk/branches: inside Trunk, >= 0.3 deep, y >= 0.3 (8% of non-lawn)
slotClasses.1: blossom deep: inside a blossom shell, >= 0.6 deep, lower/inner canopy
slotClasses.2: blossom mid: inside a blossom shell, >= 0.6 deep
slotClasses.3: blossom pale: inside a blossom shell, >= 0.6 deep, upper/outer canopy (1-3 together 78% of non-lawn, split 30/40/30)
slotClasses.4: lawn: inside Base, y in [-2.2, -0.6], >= 0.6 deep, >= 1.0 from the pond basin, >= 0.5 clear of the trunk and props
slotClasses.5: wood: inside Bridge, >= 0.5 deep, y >= 0.5; empty, the bridge is nowhere 0.5 thick (its 8% went to blossoms)
slotClasses.6: stone: inside Lantern or Rocks, >= 0.5 deep, y >= 0.5 (10% of non-lawn)
slotClasses.7: pond water: in the basin under Water, >= 0.5 from the surface, the bed and every prop (4% of non-lawn)
